subject.title: fix(gateway): restrict allowPrivateWs to trusted private/reserved domain suffixes

question: Which hostname contract should OpenClaw allow for plaintext `ws://` when `OPENCLAW_ALLOW_INSECURE_PRIVATE_WS=1` is set?
rationale: The PR changes a documented break-glass security boundary and currently includes a delegated public TLD, so automation should not choose the suffix policy or compatibility tradeoff alone.

options.title: Narrow and document the suffix contract
options.body: Remove public suffixes such as `.ai`, update docs and caller tests to the approved private/reserved names, and require real gateway/client proof before merge.

options.title: Defer to the canonical security thread
options.body: Close or pause this PR and handle the WebSocket policy as part of the broader open hardening issue.

options.title: Accept current compatibility behavior
options.body: Keep the existing broad private-DNS break-glass behavior and reject this narrowing unless a maintainer sponsors a stricter migration plan.

recommendation.title: Narrow and document the suffix contract
recommendation.body: Remove public suffixes such as `.ai`, update docs and caller tests to the approved private/reserved names, and require real gateway/client proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest merged history across this gateway policy, docs, env propagation, and caller tests.
